gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.appearan: Click with a block, or shift-click one in your inventory, to pick how the barrier looks when solid. Click with an empty hand to clear. The block is not consumed.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.all: Filter: the barrier reacts to you, your co-owners and your team. With no filter ticked it reacts to everyone.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.pea: Filter: the barrier reacts to peaceful mobs. With no filter ticked it reacts to everyone.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.hos: Filter: the barrier reacts to hostile mobs. With no filter ticked it reacts to everyone.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.inv: Solid by default, opens for filtered entities while active.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.red: Only active while any block of the barrier is powered.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.flag.inv: Entities the barrier is open for cannot see it.
gui.voidheart.permeable_barrier.team.too: Members of the owning team can configure the barrier and count as allies.

yacl3.config.voidheart:config.title: Void Heart
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.leyLineTra: Generate Old Anchors on well connected ley nodes. Anchors already built in the world stay.
Share of Old Anchors found dormant and in need of awakening.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.oculusTabl: How far from an Oculus Table, horizontally, a player can be and still be followed by its projection.
When a player followed by an Oculus Table goes underground or inside a structure, or comes back out, how many seconds the table shows both the surface and the hollows before settling on one.

How far around itself, horizontally, an Oculus Table sees the land and the presence of entities without any Beholder. Beyond what it and its Beholders see, it only shows the elevation of the land as generated.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.beholderLo: How far around itself, horizontally, a Beholder sees the land and the presence of entities for the Oculus Tables of its owner.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.beholderHi: How far around itself, horizontally, a Beholder makes out player names and mob types.
voidheart.anchor.silent: This anchor is silent: no ley line reaches it
voidheart.anchor.dormant: %s is dormant: it must be awakened by touching it
voidheart.travel_map.title: Ley paths from %s
voidheart.travel_map.dormant: Dormant: must be awakened by touching it
voidheart.travel_map.empty: No other anchor answers along these lines
voidheart.shoulder_eye.lore: Perches on your shoulder and burns those who hunt or hurt you. Sneak with an empty hand on it to take it back.
voidheart.shoulder_eye.already_bound: An eye already watches over you

%1$s was seared by the eye of %2$s using %3$s
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.shoulderEy: Damage dealt by each beam of a Shoulder Eye.
How far from its owner a Shoulder Eye fires at the mobs hunting them and the players who hurt them.
How many seconds a slain Shoulder Eye takes to grow back before flying back to its owner.
research.voidheart.altar_rite.desc: How to raise an altar to what lies outside. Unlocks the Void Altar.
research.voidheart.void_flesh.desc: What the altar will take, and what it gives back. Unlocks the Void Amalgam, the Heart, Pearls, the Eye in a Bottle and Void Lamps.
research.voidheart.archive_expansion.des: Carve further into the tablet, so that it holds more.
research.voidheart.patient_study.desc: The repository learns to listen while nobody is there.
research.voidheart.shatter_forge.desc: Matter can be thrown through the Void and come back changed. Unlocks the Shatter Forge and crafted Monoliths.
research.voidheart.portal_flexion.desc: Two places can be folded onto each other. Unlocks the Portal Core.
research.voidheart.void_husbandry.desc: Small, obedient things the altar can grow. Unlocks the Experience Skull, the Inventory Inserter and the Void Conduit.
research.voidheart.far_sight.desc: An eye needs no body to look through. Unlocks the Oculus Table.
research.voidheart.vast_archive.desc: The tablet is larger on the inside than it first let on.
research.voidheart.steady_mind.desc: The repository keeps a thought going long after you stopped feeding it.
research.voidheart.shoulder_eye.desc: An eye that follows you of its own will. Unlocks the Shoulder Eye.
research.voidheart.beholder.desc: A table can look through other eyes than its own. Unlocks the Beholder.
research.voidheart.boundless_archive.des: The tablet stops pretending it has an edge.
research.voidheart.outside_thought.desc: Something else is thinking in the repository now. It shares.
voidheart.knowledge_tablet.lore: Place it on a Void Pillar
voidheart.knowledge.exhausted: Nothing more can be learned from %s
voidheart.knowledge.full: The repository can hold no more knowledge
voidheart.knowledge.not_owner: This repository answers to someone else
voidheart.research.full: The repository is full. More is lost.
voidheart.research.unread_desc: Its shape is there. Its meaning is not.
voidheart.research.fed_spent: Nothing more can be learned from it
voidheart.research.whisper.begin: A revealed research waits to begin.
voidheart.research.whisper.starving: The research starves. Feed the repository.
voidheart.research.feed_hint: Use something strange on the repository.
voidheart.research.whisper.refine: Enough has gathered to craft an insight.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.researchGa: Refuse the recipes named by a research until that research is done. Turn it off to keep the old progression, in an existing world for example.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.knowledgeB: How much knowledge a repository gathers by itself each second, before research.
How much knowledge a player can hold, before research.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.insightBas: How much knowledge the first insight costs.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.insightCos: How much pricier each insight is than the one before. 1.20 means 20%.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.knowledgeF: Chance for each broken monolith block to drop a Knowledge Tablet, until the player has held one.
yacl3.config.voidheart:config.knowledgeT: Chance for each broken monolith block to drop a Knowledge Tablet, once the player has held one.
